spanish.s-roleplay.c2.0006.problem: Context is volunteering in a natural park but Q1 asks what type of excursion the candidate is looking for; Q2/Q4/Q5 also read as a hiking-trip scenario.
spanish.s-roleplay.c2.0006.fix: Change context to 'Quieres hacer una excursión en un parque natural' or change Q1 to '¿Qué tipo de trabajo voluntario te interesa?'.

spanish.s-roleplay.c3.0010.problem: Context is a mobile phone shop because the phone is broken, but Q1/Q2 ask why and how long the candidate needs 'el ordenador', which the context never mentions.
spanish.s-roleplay.c3.0010.fix: Add to context that the shop rents computers/internet while the phone is repaired, or change Q1 to '¿Qué problema tiene tu móvil?' and Q2 to '¿Cuándo lo compraste?'.

spanish.s-roleplay.e1.0003.problem: Hotel receptionist asks how long the candidate has studied Spanish and what is hardest about Spanish (off-context), and switches register between usted (Q1, Q5) and tú (Q2, Q3).
spanish.s-roleplay.e1.0003.fix: Replace Q2/Q3 with hotel-relevant tasks (e.g. '¿Cuántas noches quiere quedarse?', '¿Prefiere una habitación con vista al mar o a la ciudad? ‖ ¿Por qué?') and keep usted throughout.

spanish.s-roleplay.e2.0005.problem: Context is chatting with a friend about festivals, but Q1 opens with 'Buenos días, ¿para quién es el regalo?' (no gift in context) and Q3 pairs '¿Qué le gusta hacer?' with an unrelated '¿Qué regalo prefieres?'; also 'amigo español' in Buenos Aires.
spanish.s-roleplay.e2.0005.fix: Context: 'Estás en Buenos Aires y buscas un regalo con un amigo argentino'; Q3: '¿Qué le gusta hacer? ‖ ¿Qué regalo le vas a comprar?'.
